text: A marketplace for handmade crafts. Sellers sign up, list items with photos and pricing and watch their own sales; buyers search by category, read reviews and check out with Stripe. We take 8% commission and pay sellers out weekly. Disputes land with our two-person support team, and an admin can suspend a seller. Twelve weeks to launch, roughly $60k. We call it working at 200 active sellers and $50k GMV a month by month six.
notes: Three sides (seller, buyer, admin) plus commission and payouts make this a marketplace rather than a shop. No stack is mentioned at all, so P-04 is MISSING while the rest is rich.
